title: M8 confirmatory optimal-design and Bayesian active-learning benchmark
scope: Controlled synthetic evaluation of parameter-specific identifiability, measurement design, model-form robustness and topology active learning using production HydroSheaf interfaces; no field-validation claim is permitted.

objectives.statement: Quantify dispersivity and decay recovery separately across controlled transport sampling designs.
acceptance_criteria: Report parameter-specific log-error, uncertainty coverage, and paired bootstrap intervals.
Use a noise-whitened Jacobian in log10-parameter space.
Do not infer significance by treating deterministic sampling designs as random observations.

objectives.statement: Test whether target-specific and joint Fisher-information criteria select different next observations and whether their predicted advantages transfer to realised recovery.
acceptance_criteria: Use common random numbers and common starting values across strategies.
Compare parameter-targeted, D-, A-, E-, balanced, random, redundant, and no-new-measurement strategies.
Separate local-start performance from distant-start sensitivity.

objectives.statement: Verify the structural k-times-surface-area non-identifiability in the production PHREEQC kinetic adapter and test an independent surface-area constraint as the identifying intervention.
acceptance_criteria: Use the production KineticCalibrationAdapter and PHREEQC forward calculation.
Demonstrate constant-product ridge invariance and a rank-one data-only Fisher matrix.
Show that an independent surface-area observation restores full local rank.

objectives.statement: Test whether the matched-model transport design result transfers to independently generated numerical truth and whether the existing active-learning routine can express a transport sampling-time decision.
acceptance_criteria: Pass a preregistered numerical-grid convergence gate.
Use separate development-oracle and locked-test replicate families.
Do not translate categorical topology recommendations into transport times ad hoc.

objectives.statement: Prospectively qualify explicit, cost-aware and finite-scenario-robust Bayesian active learning for sequential topology-measurement design under independent controlled-synthetic aquifer truth.
acceptance_criteria: Outperform random acquisition in paired Brier score and joint-hypothesis information per cost.
Remain noninferior to a strong legacy uncertainty-chemistry policy within frozen Brier and information-efficiency margins.
Meet candidate-recall, actionability and PR-AUC non-harm gates and regenerate all registered outputs byte-identically.

inputs.provenance: HydroSheaf checkout containing production transport and kinetic adapters
Hash-locked independent numerical truth and active-learning portability runner
Hash-locked robust Bayesian topology active-learning runner with an independent MODFLOW 6/MODPATH 7 generator

risks.risk: Raw-parameter Fisher metrics depend on parameter units.
risks.mitigation: Differentiate with respect to log10 parameters and whiten by the declared observation error model.

risks.risk: Random starting values can become random regularisation centres.
risks.mitigation: Disable adapter-created priors for the primary data-identifiability experiment.

risks.risk: Previously inspected exploratory results cannot be retrospectively preregistered.
risks.mitigation: Use a new locked protocol, fresh run ID, and fresh seed family; label the result prospective confirmation.

risks.risk: An optimal observation selected under the analytical model may not improve every parameter under model-form discrepancy.
risks.mitigation: Generate truth with an independently implemented, grid-converged numerical solver and retain parameter-specific claim decisions.

risks.risk: A successful controlled-synthetic active-learning benchmark may be overgeneralised to field effectiveness, strong-baseline superiority or measurement modalities that were available but never selected.
risks.mitigation: Use prospective claim gates, report superiority and noninferiority separately, disclose selected modality counts, require exact regeneration, and retain explicit field and modality exclusions.
